statement: Build a one-file website for Thread & Loom, a handloom clothing boutique in Pune, where visitors can browse and filter the products, check the size guide, and place orders on WhatsApp.
audience: Shoppers in and around Pune, mostly on phones, looking for handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas.
standards: Earthy and elegant look: warm natural colours, calm spacing, a refined serif or similar heading style
Mobile first: works at 360px wide and at 1280px wide with no sideways scrolling
Only facts the Requester supplied; no invented prices, products, reviews or contact details
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
rules: Prices are shown in rupees exactly as supplied
Products without photos show an empty photo spot, not a stock image
Sarees and dupattas are free size
Lookbook outfits use only products from the supplied list
Orders go to WhatsApp +91 00000 11111; shop phone is +91 00000 22222
done_when: The page shows the name Thread & Loom, mentions Pune, and says the shop sells handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas.

All 10 products are listed with name, category, price in rupees and sizes exactly as supplied: Indigo block-print kurta 1,499 (S-XXL), Mustard handloom kurta 1,699 (S-XL), White chikankari kurta 2,199 (XS-XL), Maheshwari cotton saree 3,499, Chanderi silk-cotton saree 4,999, Ikat handloom saree 3,999, Khadi cotton shirt 1,299 (S-XXL), Linen-blend shirt 1,599 (M-XXL), Ajrakh dupatta 899, Bandhani dupatta 1,099 (sarees and dupattas free size).
Visitors can browse by category (All, Kurtas, Sarees, Shirts, Dupattas) and the product list updates when they pick one.
Visitors can filter products by size and by price range, and the list updates; free-size items are handled in the size filter.
A size guide table shows chest in inches: XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42.
A New Arrivals section shows exactly: White chikankari kurta, Ikat handloom saree, Linen-blend shirt.
Each product has an order button that opens a WhatsApp link to 910000011111 with the product name prefilled in the message.
A Lookbook section shows 3 styled outfits, each built only from the listed products.
A store section shows the address 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005, the shop phone +91 00000 22222, and the timings 11am to 9pm Tuesday to Sunday, closed Monday.
The return and exchange policy states: exchange within 7 days if unworn with tags; no returns on sale items.
A reviews section shows three reviews: "Beautiful fabric, fits perfectly" - Meera K., "Fast delivery and lovely packing" - Arjun S., "My go-to for festive kurtas" - Priya D.
Delivery information states: across Pune in 2 days, Rs 79, free above Rs 2,999, pay on delivery or UPI.
Every product card has an empty photo spot, and the page loads no stock photos.
The page has a mobile viewport tag and responsive layout rules so nothing scrolls sideways at 360px or 1280px, and it has no JavaScript errors and no broken in-page links.
visitor_needs: See a lookbook of styled outfits
Read the return and exchange policy
Know delivery cost and payment options
